    Ray presentations #

    A ray presentation of an algebra B (with primitive idempotents F) by a ray table T is a family of vectors β r, one in each nonzero ray, such that the ray products of B (Definition 3.4: [f][h] = [fh] unless fh ∈ M(f, h)) are the products of T. This is the content of "ray A_t = P with the specified representatives" (Proposition 11.3(3), binary-families.tex) and of Definition 3.9(3).

    The transported rays of a fibre of the zero-product family present B by P (fibre_rayPres): "If n ∈ rad R_y, the product rn is a combination of proper rays, so (rn)·s = (rn)s … Each correction r*s = rq_ys belongs to this subspace." With zero coefficients this shows that a representation-finite ray table presents its own linearization.

        structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PrimitiveIdempotents.IsRayPres {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (F : PrimitiveIdempotents B) {V R : Type} (T : RaySys.Mult V R) (ι : V ≃ Fin F.m) (β : R → B) :
        Prop

        A ray presentation of B by the table T.

        • corner (r : R) : β r ∈ F.corner (ι (T.src r)) (ι (T.tgt r))
        • ne (r : R) : β r ≠ 0
        • inj (r s : R) : β r ∈ F.ray (ι (T.src s)) (ι (T.tgt s)) (β s) → r = s
        • surj (x y : Fin F.m) (f : B) : f ∈ F.corner x y → f ≠ 0 → ∃ (r : R), ι (T.src r) = x ∧ ι (T.tgt r) = y ∧ f ∈ F.ray x y (β r)
        • mul_some (r s t : R) : T.mul r s = some t → β r * β s ∉ F.insertionSpan (ι (T.src r)) (ι (T.tgt r)) (ι (T.tgt s)) (β r) (β s) ∧ β r * β s ∈ F.ray (ι (T.src t)) (ι (T.tgt t)) (β t)
        • mul_none (r s : R) : T.mul r s = none → T.tgt r = T.src s → β r * β s ∈ F.insertionSpan (ι (T.src r)) (ι (T.tgt r)) (ι (T.tgt s)) (β r) (β s)
